summary: Validated Smart Product Tags backend + UI contract. Targeted pytest passed serially (7/7) after identifying xdist race flakiness on shared singleton tag settings. UI verified Store Management → Tag Settings round-trip save, product-grid smart chips, and Product Detail Deal toggle/expiry input.

critical.issue: No app-auth session cookie is set on login (response returns profile JSON only; observed Set-Cookie is Cloudflare __cf_bm, not app session).
No brute-force lockout after repeated failed attempts (attempts 1-6 all returned 401 without lockout state).

minor.issue: Configured as allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*'; wildcard origin is incompatible with credentialed browser requests.
Smart-tag tests are flaky under parallel xdist workers because they mutate global singleton /api/tag-settings and shared ranking data.

issues: Broken image source detected in console: /api/image-proxy?url=https://example.com/thumb1.jpg returns 404 (non-feature seed/media data quality issue).

action_items: For auth hardening playbook parity: implement server-managed httpOnly auth cookie/session for admin login or update playbook/spec if localStorage-only is intentional.
Set explicit CORS origins when allow_credentials=True (avoid wildcard).
Mark smart-tag pytest suite as serial (or isolate tag settings per test) to avoid xdist races.
Clean/replace broken seed image URLs that route through /api/image-proxy.
critical_code_review_comments: Smart tag feature logic itself is working: /api/tag-settings validation/persistence, admin smart_tags/smart_tag_ids alongside seo tags, storefront tags + smart_tag_ids + seo_tags + deal_ends_at, Deal expiry behavior, and anonymous /api/store/products/{id}/view flow are all passing.
Primary instability source is shared mutable singleton state under parallel tests, not smart-tag business logic failure.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 on serial rerun; initial parallel run flaky)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (core requested flows passed; minor broken-image console 404)

test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used qa@prettycheap.com.au / QaTest123! for UI login.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary product TEST_UI_SMART_TAG_PRODUCT via public API for UI validation and deleted it after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_smart_tag_contract.py for regression coverage. Run smart-tag tests serially (-n 1) due singleton-tag-settings race under xdist. Feature APIs are stable; unresolved items are auth hardening and CORS policy quality.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (flaky backend run): initial failures were caused by parallel xdist workers concurrently patching/restoring singleton /api/tag-settings and shared ranking inputs, producing cross-test label mismatches. Reproduction: run smart-tag tests with xdist workers >1. Mitigation: serialise suite or isolate mutable globals. RCA-2 (auth playbook gaps): admin login endpoint returns account payload without app session cookie and no lockout state after repeated failures; current design appears localStorage-session based.
